Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check first: is story 3 done, is story 4’s task 19 done, is task 15 done, and did you flag task 19 if it slipped—and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12 (Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry), which is still blocked?
Then tell us what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Noted: you finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two, and today you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests, with nothing blocking you.

Daniel, story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock getting the idempotency keys in so you can pick the summary page back up?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.
Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, quick check: is story 5 done, is bug 12 done, is story 2 done, and is task 16 done?
Then please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I'll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for bug 12 with the sandbox gateway timing out and needing access to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Noted: blocker is that staging access is needed to pair on the gateway timeouts, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up; commitment is that you’ll pair with him on staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted a blocker that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review, and your commitment to chase them today; blockers will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done?
Then please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted that you finished refund API tests, are working on the payment retry story today, and have no blockers.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
For the sandbox being down that slipped task 14, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the commitment: I’ll sync with her after the stand-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised today include bug 12 with sandbox gateway timeouts needing staging access, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, and earlier sandbox downtime; the summary page is on track and will resume after idempotency keys are in. We also parked an offline side discussion about gateway timeouts. One item was not covered: task 19, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams. Thanks everyone.
